title: AMD Radeon Cloud real-call smoke evidence (sanitized)
description: Records the observable result of one real streaming call made through pi's own adapter against the AMD Radeon Cloud free endpoint. The API key is a secret and is intentionally NOT stored here; the reproducible gated smoke lives in packages/ai/test/stream.test.ts (AMD block, triggered by AMD_RADEON_API_KEY).
notes: Ran through pi's openai-completions adapter (compat.streamSimple -> builtinModels amd-radeon).
Reasoning is streamed by default as delta.reasoning (delta.content carries the final text); pi surfaces it as thinking blocks.
The endpoint does not support store / developer role / reasoning_effort, so compat sets those to false to avoid rejected requests.
